evidence.title: Greeter runtime overrides were absent from benign-looking stored messages
evidence.observation: According to MM1’s 4 November original-source inspection, Era reports seven deliberately vulnerable Flowise honeypots with 4,972 stored user messages saying hello. Per-request JavaScript overrides carried malicious commands without changing saved workflows.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.

terms.name: Reference environment integrity
